cc:Work.dc:title: Pure-state indicator autocorrelation
cc:Work.dc:description: Pure-state indicator ACF, alpha=0.99, N=100. Six configurations, 12 paired runs per configuration. Shading gives pointwise 95% bootstrap intervals from 50,000 whole-run resamples. Lags use process time or sweeps.
